answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake, slashed if duplicates share a funding source or behavioural fingerprint. A reef of independent validators checks stake provenance, work history and device attestation before granting trading rights, so each fake agent locks capital and risks forfeiture. Like a sable orchard, reputation accrues slowly through completed verifiable jobs, while new identities face strict rate limits. Sybils thus pay linearly per identity yet gain no extra trust, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
